Results.ReviewText: We are retired, so its just my wife and I, and the Spirit E-325 is the perfect grill for our retired lifestyle. The E-325 is loaded with the features that we like including 3 burners (2 with sear functions), cast aluminum firebox, cast iron grills and folding side tables. The grill heats up quickly and can easily reach 600° WITHOUT using the sear functionality. This is a powerful 3 burner grill packed into a 2 burner footprint. We considered getting a larger grill, looking very seriously at the Weber Genesis II E-335, but the footprint size, 3 burner/sear and the folding side tables were the overriding factors for us. Previously we have owned 4 Weber gas grills in addition to our Q2200 that we use for Glamping and of course a 22" Weber Kettle and a Smokey Joe (back in the day). Our last grill was a bargain brand grill (N) that didn't hold up the way our Webers have done in the past so back to Weber for us.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback and for choosing a Weber grill!  Your grill should quickly reach 450F.

If your grill is not getting to that temperature quickly and taking a long time to recover heat, then it isn't working properly.

It sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. 

Perform a soapy water leak test to check for leaks. If there is no leak, follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is not only the reset, but how you want to light your grill each and every time.

Open the lid
Make sure all knobs are in the off position
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 60 seconds
Turn the first burner to start/high
Hit your igniter
Turn on remaining burners one at a time and set each to high
Close the lid
Let your grill preheat to 450°F

Our Specialist team is here to help. Please look for our email outreach soon. Thank you!
